notes: Mage-VL-Cowork_vision-fp16.litertlm of litert-community/Mage-VL-Cowork: microsoft/Mage-VL-Cowork (Apache-2.0; a 4B computer-use agent: a 24-layer vision encoder and a Qwen3-4B text decoder) converted to LiteRT-LM as a fast_vlm bundle that reads one 1920 x 1088 screenshot per request and writes the agent's next action. Published 2026-11-05 (Hub main 38bf428b at the read). Measured 2026-11-04 in the runs r7 and r9 (the published bytes).
quantization: the same decoder, embedding table and adapter as Mage-VL-Cowork.litertlm (INT4 decoder, 4,096-token KV cache, FP16 on the GPU); a vision encoder with FP16 fully connected weights and biases and the model metadata reduced_precision_support = fp16accfp16 for XNNPACK's FP16 path on the CPU; one 1920 x 1088 screenshot per request (2,040 image tokens)
